claims.head: Where the Sabres have the edge: shot suppression
claims.body: The Sabres are around the middle of the league for shot suppression, and the Blackhawks are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

BUF.head: The Sabres should be favored
BUF.body: Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. If the Blackhawks want to spoil it, start with a penalty kill that holds up.

CHI.head: The Blackhawks have their work cut out
CHI.body: Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Blackhawks can still win it if their penalty kill holds up, but a lot has to go their way.
